en: "What's the holdup? I said I'd give you a Strong Vine, so hurry up and calm the Dodo King down."{w}
"Oh, thanks a lot!{w}I really need to get along a bit better with that thing.{w}Anyway, here's your reward. Take it!"{w}

[Key Item]
You obtained the Strong Vine.{w}
"See ya."{w}
It seems to be a storehouse.{w}Better not touch anything without permission.{w}
A giant dodo is kept here, running around energetically.{w}{p}When it notices you, it comes charging at you furiously!{w}
You sent the Dodo King flying.{w}
It might have calmed down a little.{w}
A giant dodo is kept here, running around energetically.{w}{p}...Maybe a little too energetically.{w}Could it be angry?{w}
"Hm? Who are you? Need something?"{w}
note: ??? = Soara before she gives her name (2660).

en: "Here to enroll?"
"Hmm. In that case, you'd better go say hello to the Principal.{w}I'll show you the way."{w}
"I'm Soara. Nice to meet you."{w}
"Well, well~ I never thought I'd actually get my hands on one.{w}It was worth lining up without a care for who was watching~{w}Snort-hee-hee."{w}
note: ??? = the Principal (Soara introduces him next row); he is holding the Mont Blanc (2696).

en: "Principal, perfect timing.{w}This is the Principal of Rubenburg."{w}
note: First sentence to the Principal, second to the party.

en: "Oh my, a new student, is it?{w}Our school places great value on students' independence, you seeee~{w}Being bright and lively is what we're known for, you knooow~"{w}
Carefree Voice
"Ahaha~{w}Teehee~"{w}
"There, doesn't that sound like fun~?"{w}
Female Student
"Eeeeek!?"{w}
Stern Voice

"Hey, you there, second-year!
Grab Harmoni!"{w}
Male Student
"Wh-what? N-no way, I can't!{w}It's way too dangerous!!"{w}
"Professor Harmoni is a genius~ Hee hee~"{w}
note: Harmoni speaks of themself in the third person (cf. 2708, 2733).

en:
"You idiot, don't juggle it!
If you drop it..."{w}
"Can you hear that~?{w}All my kids here are so full of energy, you seeee~{w}They're our school's pride and joy~"{w}
"Ooh, ooh~ I smell something nice and sugary~?{w}It's this way~"{w}
"Harmoni?{w}Hey, where are you going! Get over here, now..."{w}
"Sniff sniff sniff~?"{w}
"See? Sweeets~"{w}
"Ah, well, well, if it isn't Professor Harmoni.{w}Good afternoon. Snort."{w}
Professor Harmoni
note: Glossary form, 17 chars (over ~16); 'Prof. Harmoni' if it does not fit.

en: "Good afternooon to you~{w}Principal, what's that you're holding~?"{w}
"Ah, this is a confection called a Mont Blanc, and I was just about to eat it with the School Nurse~"{w}{p}"...W-wait, Professor, what on earth are YOU holding~!?"{w}
"Gre~naaa~~~de~"{w}
"Snort! Not again!?"{w}
Professor Warmoni
note: Glossary form, 17 chars (over ~16); 'Prof. Warmoni' if it does not fit.

en: "Harmoni, knock it off!{w}Hand that grenade over here!!"{w}
"Nooope~{w}If you want one, Professor Warmoni, make your own~"{w}
"I don't want one, dammit -- who'd want that thing!{w}If it blows up, it'll be a disaster..."{w}
"It's fine~ Professor Harmoni is immortal~"{w}
"P-Professor Harmoni, didn't I b-beg you over and over not to make grenades~?"{w}
"Hmm~?"{w}
"Ehehe~~"{w}
"A-anyway, couldn't you leave that with me, pleeease~!?"{w}
"I. Won't. Give. It. Uuup~{w}But I'll trade it for that sweet, the Mont Blanc thingy~"{w}
"Hey, Principal! Just hand over that stupid sweet!!"{w}
note: [JP] rendered 'that stupid sweet' (dismissive); avoids a pronoun for Harmoni.

en: "N-no, I can't!{w}This is for the School Nurse, who's always been so good to me, treating my back pain..."{w}
"I want it~ I'm drooling~"{w}
"Would you rather have an explosion!?"{w}
"W-well, I suppose it can't be helped~{w}I'll give it to you, so please hand the grenade over heeere~"{w}
The Principal gave the Mont Blanc to Professor Harmoni.{w}
"Yaaay~ So now I trade you the grenade, right~{w}Professor Harmoni is a good little kid who keeps promises~"{w}
{0E}             *  Whoops  *             {0F}{w}
The grenade's pin caught on Professor Harmoni's finger and came right out!{w}
"Snorrrk!?"{w}
"Harmoni! The pin just..."{w}
"La-la-laaa~ Mont Blaaanc~ Yaaay~"{w}
"Why, that...!"{w}
"P-Professor Warmoni!{w}Wh-wh-wh-what am I supposed to doooo~!?"{w}
"All we can do now is run!{w}Everyone, get away from the Principaaal!"{w}
"J-just waaait a moment, plea... Whaaaat!?"{w}
"Principal, use {11:0001:0016} and dump it somewhere!"{w}
note: {11:0001:0016} = spell name insert (a teleport/escape spell, cf. slice 032 SCD01:3690).

en: "I'm not in active practice anymore, you knooow~{w}Forget spells -- about all I remember is how to stamp a seal~ Snort."{w}
"No choice, then... New student!{w}You're coming with me -- we're getting out of here by spell!"{w}
"Oh, I'm so sorry about this~{w}Just what I'd expect from Soara, top of the class~{w}Well then, I'll just tag along with you as weeell~..."{w}
"Principal, you'll have to deal with this yourself!{w}If we escape by spell and the grenade comes along with us, what's the point!?"{w}
"Wh-wh-what!?{w}Th-then, what about meee...{w}What's going to happen to meeee!?"{w}
"I see.{w}Just don't wander around too freely, or people will take you for an intruder. Keep it in moderation."{w}
note: Reply to 'no' on the enrolment prompt (2656); speaker ??? = Soara.

en: "That was close...{w}Okay, then let me explain how this school works."{w}{p}"This school has three floors.{w}The first floor is the first-years' floor.{w}The Career Guidance Office is there too, among other things."{w}
Principal's Voice
"Snoooort!?"{w}

"The second floor is the second-years' floor.{w}Vice Principal Kathleen's Magic Research Wing and the infirmary are on this floor too."{w}{p}"The third floor is the third-years' floor.{w}The Principal's Office is on the east side of it."{w}{p}"This school runs purely on merit.{w}Attending for a year doesn't mean you get to be a second-year."{w}{p}"Only once you pass the Completion Exam for your year can you move up to the next one."{w}{p}"So quick learners end up graduating in less than a year."{w}{p}"On the other hand, some people can't graduate and just stay third-years forever.{w}Well, how far you get depends on how hard you study."{w}{p}"Once you've passed the Completion Exams for all three years, collect your diploma at the Principal's Office."{w}{p}"Any questions so far?{w}None? Good.{w}Then off you go."{w}{p}"I'll be here.{w}I'm looking forward to the day you graduate."{w}
note: New terms: Magic Research Wing ([JP]). | Accuracy: [JP] -> Completion Exam, matching the exam series used in slices 052/055/056 (Year N Completion Exam). | Accuracy: (same)

en: "Just so you know, you can't cheat.{w}This is a place that teaches spells, so of course there are countermeasures against cheating with spells, too."{w}{p}"If you get caught, you'll be in big trouble.{w}Haste makes waste. Keep at it, one step at a time."{w}
"Huh? Miria's looking for me?{w}...I see."{w}
"You graduated? Congratulations!"{w}{p}"I've heard all about it.{w}Sounds like you worked pretty hard.{w}Be proud of graduating from Rubenburg!"{w}

"By the way...{w}I have a favor to ask you, since I'm counting on your strength."{w}{p}"At this school, above the Principal, there's the Board Chair.{w}The Chair usually stays somewhere out of sight, but appears to guide us when we need it."{w}{p}"But lately, there's been a rumor that the Board Chair...{w}has gotten mixed up in a forbidden arcane experiment."{w}{p}"The forbidden arcane experiment is a grand feat: casting {11:0001:0015} three times at once."{w}{p}"It's an extremely dangerous act that could destroy the land itself."{w}{p}"Even a single {11:0001:0015} takes a huge amount of power, so normally it would be impossible..."{w}{p}"But the Board Chair just might..."{w}
note: [JP] = 'arcane experiment' (glossary). {11:0001:0015} = spell name insert; 'three times at once' avoids pluralising the insert. No pronoun for the Chair. | Accuracy: restored [JP] (forbidden) dropped in both mentions; fixed "a arcane". | Accuracy: (same)
